plugin.legacy.installed.unknownTier: This plugin declares a trust tier this version of Baram does not recognize, so it cannot be loaded. Update Baram and try again.
plugin.error.updateUnverifiableFloor: "{name}" does not say which Baram version it needs — neither its registry listing nor the downloaded package states a `>=x.y.z` floor. Updating replaces the working copy in one step, so this refuses rather than risk leaving you with a version that will not start. Uninstall and install it yourself if you want to proceed.
